detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require externally confirmed cardiovascular/adult/no-contraindication context. In the source-qualified local-day activity series, require at least 7 prior positive days, a prior 14-day positive median, two prior days below that median, and a current day above 150 percent of the median. Open one optional next easy-buffer action; do not infer cardiovascular state, fitness, fatigue, recovery, risk, safety or compliance.

numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: current local-day activity signal above 150 percent of the prior 14-day positive median after two prior below-median days and at least 7 prior positive days, plus external cardiovascular/adult/no-contraindication context

detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing any external gate, provider identity, coverage or uncertainty boundary emits no trigger; missing data is unknown, not low activity.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: AHA/ACC supports a bounded lower-intensity lifestyle activity action. Device data supplies only a high-after-quiet activity-load behavior opportunity and does not measure cardiovascular state, fitness, fatigue, recovery, risk, safety, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, compliance, delivery, frequency or deduplication.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit one context row only when the external cardiovascular/adult/no-contraindication gate and source-qualified high-after-quiet activity-load opportunity are present.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when any external gate, provider/source identity, coverage or uncertainty boundary is missing.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: KDB output opens one bounded next activity-load easy-buffer opportunity only; operating product owns timing, suppression, delivery, frequency and deduplication.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when any external gate, provider/source identity, coverage or uncertainty boundary is missing.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.

provider_contracts.method: For each observed Apple provider local week, sum source-qualified aerobic minutes from Workouts of at least 10 minutes with overlapping same-source PhysicalEffort intervals. Count MET >=3.0 minutes toward the moderate branch and MET >=6.0 minutes toward the vigorous branch. Emit context when weekly moderate minutes >300 or weekly vigorous minutes >150.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Apple Workout plus same-source PhysicalEffort MET intervals can support a source-qualified weekly high activity-volume context. Supported use: Close the existing general inactivity-gap move prompt from source-qualified no/low-movement interval context without requiring a subsequent movement event.. Boundary: This is bounded daily-health prompt context only. It is not measured sitting, sedentary-time measurement, glucose or insulin improvement, vascular diagnosis, disease-risk prediction, exact break-dose prescription, readiness/recovery/formula score, service action, diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice.. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open easy-restart copy: lower the first movement burden to a very short stand, stretch, or walk. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open transition-anchor copy: attach one tiny movement to the next natural transition point instead of creating a separate workout plan. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open one optional light household-chore action; chore availability remains unknown and is not inferred. Require external diabetes and adult context before opening one optional light household-chore action; do not infer diabetes or glycemic state.

provider_contracts.method: For each observed Apple provider local week, sum source-qualified MVPA minutes and count distinct MVPA local days from aerobic Workouts of at least 10 minutes with overlapping same-source PhysicalEffort intervals at MET >=3.0. Emit the context when weekly MVPA minutes <150 or distinct MVPA days <3.

This is not diabetes diagnosis, glycemic control, hypoglycemia detection, treatment advice, activity clearance, universal intensity equivalence, or proof of off-device behavior.

The new line uses the same qualified timing context only to open one small sleep-timing anchor action. Use this source-qualified context only to open one flexible next-week sleep-timing continuation action; do not infer a fixed schedule or sleep state. provider_contracts.method: Read positive FlightsClimbed records, reconcile source identity, sum by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current count is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded cumulative FlightsClimbed only; no equivalence to stair ability, strength, balance, intensity, or target.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded cycling distance by local day; require seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded cycling distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded exercise minutes by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded exercise-time change only; Apple field estimation is not adopted as individual intensity.

provider_contracts.method: On complete local days, detect a prior positive recorded exercise-time day followed by two complete days without a positive recorded value; missing coverage yields unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The signal is provider-recorded exercise time, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Count distinct valid stood-hour categories per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current count is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded category-count change, not standing duration, sedentary time, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded standing time by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded standing-time change only and is not a sedentary-time estimate.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded distance by local day; require at least seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded walking/running distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, health, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current active_time is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded active-time change, not energy balance, all-activity change, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day, require seven valid positive prior days, and emit on the second of two consecutive observed days below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded active_time gap only; missing data is not no movement.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-distance sessions, reconcile source identity, sum recorded distance by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current distance is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded exercise distance only; no equivalence to total movement or target.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-duration sessions, reconcile source identity, sum duration by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current duration is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded session duration only; no intensity or target equivalence.

provider_contracts.method: Resolve positive Samsung exercise sessions by local day; require a prior positive session, four subsequent complete coverage days without a session, and a three-day quiet window after a prior emitted context. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: This output describes a Samsung-recorded session gap only, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung activity.day_summary longest_active_time to one representative value per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded longest-bout change, not total activity, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive provider pedometer-distance rows, reconcile source identity and local day, aggregate one daily value, require seven valid prior days, and emit when the current daily value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require externally confirmed dyslipidemia/adult context and external activity-restriction boundary plus a complete provider week with activity concentrated on one or two days and a qualified next-week anchor window. Open one next-week activity-distribution action; do not infer lipid status, fitness, treatment response, fatigue, recovery, safety, exercise clearance or adherence.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing any external condition, age, restriction, provider identity, coverage, personal baseline, concentrated-week context or next-week anchor window emits no trigger; missing data is unknown, not need.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: The dyslipidemia and WHO sources support regular weekly activity. Device data supplies only a concentrated-week behavior opportunity and does not measure lipid status, fitness, disease control, treatment response, fatigue, recovery, safety, exercise clearance, adherence, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, delivery, frequency or deduplication.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit one context row only when external dyslipidemia/adult/activity-restriction context, concentrated weekly activity and a qualified next-week anchor window are present.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when condition context, adult boundary, external restriction boundary, provider identity, coverage, personal baseline, concentrated-week context or next-week anchor window is missing.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: KDB output opens one bounded next-week activity-distribution opportunity only; operating product owns timing, suppression, safety escalation, delivery, frequency and deduplication.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when condition context, adult boundary, external restriction boundary, provider identity, coverage, personal baseline, concentrated-week context or next-week anchor window is missing.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.

provider_contracts.method: For each observed Apple provider local week, count distinct local days with an aerobic Workout of at least 10 minutes that has at least 10 continuous same-source PhysicalEffort minutes at MET >=3.0 for the moderate branch and MET >=6.0 for the vigorous branch. Emit the context only when moderate qualified days <5 and vigorous qualified days <3.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Apple Workout plus same-source PhysicalEffort MET intervals can support a source-qualified weekly moderate/vigorous aerobic session-day alternative context for users whose dyslipidemia status is supplied by operating/profile input. This is not lipid improvement, diagnosis, risk scoring, treatment, activity clearance, universal intensity equivalence, or proof of off-device behavior.

provider_contracts.method: For each observed Health Connect provider local week, count distinct local days with at least one source-identified ActivityIntensityRecord interval whose intensity is moderate or vigorous and whose continuous duration is at least 10 minutes. Same-day short intervals are not accumulated in this KDB candidate path. Emit the DYS context only when moderate qualified days <5 and vigorous qualified days <3.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Health Connect ActivityIntensityRecord can support a source-qualified weekly moderate/vigorous aerobic session-day alternative context when dyslipidemia status is supplied by operating/profile input and observed week/source identity/overlap gates are met. This is not lipid improvement, diagnosis, risk scoring, treatment, activity clearance, universal intensity equivalence, or proof of off-device behavior.

Open one familiar aerobic planning action; do not infer lipid status, fitness, treatment response, fatigue, recovery, safety, exercise clearance or adherence.

numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: confirmed dyslipidemia context plus observed Health Connect provider week with moderate session days below 5 and vigorous session days below 3

detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing any external condition, age, restriction, provider identity, coverage or uncertainty boundary emits no trigger; missing data is unknown, not need.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: The dyslipidemia and WHO sources support regular weekly activity. Device data supplies only a weekly behavior opportunity and does not measure lipid status, fitness, disease control, treatment response, fatigue, recovery, safety, exercise clearance, adherence, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, delivery, frequency or deduplication.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit one context row only when external dyslipidemia/adult/activity-restriction context and a complete qualified provider week are present.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when condition context, adult boundary, external restriction boundary, provider identity, coverage or uncertainty boundary is missing.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: KDB output opens one bounded weekly planning opportunity only; operating product owns timing, suppression, safety escalation, delivery, frequency and deduplication.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when condition context, adult boundary, external restriction boundary, provider identity, coverage or uncertainty boundary is missing.
missingness_policy: Missing Workout or PhysicalEffort timestamp, MET value, duration, type, or source identity prevents qualification for that event; do not substitute steps, calories, active energy, generic workout presence, Samsung labels, or Health Connect exercise type alone.
If type, duration, timestamp, MET value, same-source overlap, or source identity is missing, the event is not qualified; missing is not proof of no exercise.
If no Apple provider source was observed for the week, return no trigger/unknown rather than interpreting missing exports as low activity.
If dyslipidemia context is not confirmed, source identity is missing, week source is unobserved, provider is unsupported, moderate days >=5, or vigorous days >=3, emit no trigger.

Missing record type, timestamp, intensity, or dataOrigin source identity prevents qualification for that interval; do not substitute ExerciseSessionRecord type, steps, calories, speed, heart rate, or generic activity presence.
If intensity, timestamp, source identity, or the 10-minute continuous interval requirement is missing, the event is not qualified; missing or short records are not proof of low activity.
If no Health Connect provider source was observed for the week, return no trigger/unknown rather than interpreting missing exports as low activity.

If dyslipidemia context is not confirmed, source identity is missing, week source is unobserved, provider is unsupported, no qualified 10-minute intensity session day exists, moderate days >=5, or vigorous days >=3, emit no trigger.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: For each source-qualified activity-load signal, aggregate or summarize load by user-local day according to the provider contract. Evaluate each current local day with a recent 7-local-day window and a prior 14-local-day baseline window. Require at least 3 recent positive load days and at least 7 prior positive load days. Compute recent_positive_day_mean = sum(recent positive-day load) / count(recent positive days). Compute prior_positive_day_median over the prior positive load days. Trigger when recent_positive_day_mean is at least 1.5 times prior_positive_day_median. Reuse the same source-qualified personal activity-load context only to open one one-step planning action.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, unresolved local-day boundary, fewer than 3 recent positive activity-load days, fewer than 7 prior positive activity-load days, unresolved overlap, incomplete coverage, or missing timezone yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Evaluate trigger_rule= 'emit_when_recent_load_increase_exceeds_personal_baseline'. Derive trigger_measure_key= 'activity_load_gradual_progression_context' with unit= 'boolean_context_presence'. Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'general_activity_progression_apple, general_activity_progression_samsung'. Provider contracts= 2, preprocessing steps= 10, replay/calibration rows= 1. Required contexts are: general_adult_context, timestamped_activity_or_workout_records, recent_comparable_activity_history, personal_activity_load_baseline, recent_activity_load_increase, local_day_boundary, coverage_and_missingness_context, overlap_resolution. Supported use: Open a general planning line that encourages a one-step-at-a-time progression after a source-qualified activity-load increase.. Boundary: The source supports gradual progression; the device path supplies only behavioral load context. It does not infer fatigue, recovery, readiness, injury, disease, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, score, or service action.. Reuse the same source-qualified personal activity-load context only to open one one-step planning action.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: If any required context, provider contract input, preprocessing step, timezone/window assignment, coverage check, or duplicate-resolution prerequisite is unavailable, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not convert missing device data, missing user/profile input, or missing source coverage into a negative behavior label. Do not bypass the evidence boundary or create runtime delivery authority.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: The source supports gradual progression; the device path supplies only behavioral activity-load context. It does not infer fatigue, recovery, readiness, injury, disease, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, score, runtime authority, service action, or delivery timing. The new line is a one-step planning opportunity only; it does not measure fatigue, recovery, health, disease, injury, safety, clearance, treatment, or outcome.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: For each source-qualified physical-activity volume/load signal, aggregate or summarize by user-local day according to the provider contract. Require at least 7 positive prior days in the preceding 14-day window. Trigger when the current local-day signal is above 150 percent of the prior positive-day median and each of the two immediately prior local days is below that median.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing current local-day signal, fewer than 7 positive prior days, missing either of the two prior local days, unresolved overlap, or unresolved device/wear confidence yields no KDB trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Evaluate trigger_rule= 'emit_when_activity_load_spike_and_buffer_window_are_qualified'. Derive trigger_measure_key= 'activity_load_spike_buffer_context' with unit= 'boolean_context_presence'. Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'activity_load_spike_buffer_apple, activity_load_spike_buffer_samsung'. Provider contracts= 2, preprocessing steps= 12, replay/calibration rows= 1. Required contexts are: recent_activity_load_spike, usual_activity_load_baseline, recent_training_or_activity_load_proxy, provider_activity_or_workout_history, source_identity_and_revision, overlap_and_duplicate_resolution, wear_or_device_presence_confidence, missingness_policy, buffer_window_or_next_low_burden_opportunity, acute_pain_injury_clinical_rest_filter. Supported use: Close source-qualified general wellness coverage for easy buffer planning after a recent above-usual activity-load context, without requiring next-day low movement.. Boundary: This is an activity-load context for low-burden buffer planning only. It is not fatigue diagnosis, biological recovery measurement, recovery/readiness score, overtraining diagnosis, injury or performance prediction, rest or training prescription, service action, diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice..
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: If any required context, provider contract input, preprocessing step, timezone/window assignment, coverage check, or duplicate-resolution prerequisite is unavailable, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not convert missing device data, missing user/profile input, or missing source coverage into a negative behavior label. Do not bypass the evidence boundary or create runtime delivery authority.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: The trigger detects a descriptive high-after-quiet activity context from source-qualified activity signals. It does not infer fatigue, biological recovery, readiness, overtraining, injury/performance risk, intensity, fitness, prescription, diagnosis, score, runtime authority, service action, or delivery timing.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit context_present=true when current local-day daily steps are greater than 150 percent of the prior 14-day positive median, at least 7 prior positive days exist, and both immediately prior local days are below that median.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Emit no trigger when source identity, current day, either prior day, at least 7 prior positive days, positive median, duplicate resolution, or device confidence is missing; missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: External v1 documents the daily-step source path for this broader activity-load trigger; other activity-volume/load sources require their own future source-field rows.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Emit no trigger when source identity, current day, either prior day, at least 7 prior positive days, positive median, duplicate resolution, or device confidence is missing; missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive FlightsClimbed records, reconcile source identity, sum by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current count is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded cumulative FlightsClimbed only; no equivalence to stair ability, strength, balance, intensity, or target.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded cycling distance by local day; require seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded cycling distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded exercise minutes by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded exercise-time change only; Apple field estimation is not adopted as individual intensity.

provider_contracts.method: On complete local days, detect a prior positive recorded exercise-time day followed by two complete days without a positive recorded value; missing coverage yields unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The signal is provider-recorded exercise time, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Count distinct valid stood-hour categories per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current count is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded category-count change, not standing duration, sedentary time, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded standing time by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded standing-time change only and is not a sedentary-time estimate.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded distance by local day; require at least seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded walking/running distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, health, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current active_time is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded active-time change, not energy balance, all-activity change, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day, require seven valid positive prior days, and emit on the second of two consecutive observed days below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded active_time gap only; missing data is not no movement.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-distance sessions, reconcile source identity, sum recorded distance by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current distance is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded exercise distance only; no equivalence to total movement or target.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-duration sessions, reconcile source identity, sum duration by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current duration is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded session duration only; no intensity or target equivalence.

provider_contracts.method: Resolve positive Samsung exercise sessions by local day; require a prior positive session, four subsequent complete coverage days without a session, and a three-day quiet window after a prior emitted context. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: This output describes a Samsung-recorded session gap only, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung activity.day_summary longest_active_time to one representative value per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded longest-bout change, not total activity, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive provider pedometer-distance rows, reconcile source identity and local day, aggregate one daily value, require seven valid prior days, and emit when the current daily value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded pedometer distance only; no equivalence to exercise-session distance or complete movement coverage.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Build rolling windows of seven observed resolved sleep nights. Calculate sleep midpoint for each night and the median absolute circular midpoint deviation in minutes. Emit sleep_timing_regular_context_present=true when midpoint_mad_minutes <= 180. This context may support reflection copy only and must not label chronotype, social jetlag, circadian disorder, insomnia, or prescribe a sleep schedule. The new line uses the same qualified timing context only to open one calm bedtime-routine action.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Fewer than seven observed resolved sleep nights, duration-only data without timing, missing source identity, unresolved timezone/local wake date, high missingness, or shift/travel/clinical filter failure yields no trigger.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Evaluate trigger_rule= 'emit_when_multi_night_sleep_timing_variability_context_is_qualified'. Derive trigger_measure_key= 'sleep_timing_regular_context' with unit= 'boolean_context_presence'. Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'sleep_timing_regular_apple_sleep, sleep_timing_regular_samsung_sleep'. Provider contracts= 2, preprocessing steps= 12, replay/calibration rows= 1. Required contexts are: multi_night_sleep_session_history, valid_sleep_session_start_end_timezone, sleep_onset_wake_or_midpoint_by_night, main_sleep_anchor_or_sleep_session_filter, sleep_timing_variability_or_irregularity_context, sleep_duration_not_substituted_for_timing, device_presence_or_sync_confidence, shift_work_travel_or_clinical_sleep_disorder_filter, missingness_policy, context_copy_only. Supported use: Close the existing general sleep-timing regularity context line from source-qualified multi-night sleep timing history only, without turning timing variability into a diagnosis, score, or schedule prescription.. Boundary: This is bounded sleep-timing regularity context only. It is not chronotype labeling, social-jetlag diagnosis, circadian or sleep-disorder inference, sleep schedule prescription, light therapy, mental-health or cardiometabolic risk claim, cognitive-performance inference, readiness/recovery/sleep score, formula score, service action, diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice.. The new line uses the same qualified timing context only to open one calm bedtime-routine action.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: If any required context, provider contract input, preprocessing step, timezone/window assignment, coverage check, or duplicate-resolution prerequisite is unavailable, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not convert missing device data, missing user/profile input, or missing source coverage into a negative behavior label. Do not bypass the evidence boundary or create runtime delivery authority.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Apple v1: accept HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRateRecoveryOneMinute records with numeric value, source identity, parseable timestamp, and a completed Workout ending within 180 seconds before the HRR1 timestamp. Samsung v1: accept com.samsung.shealth.exercise.recovery_heart_rate rows with start/end/time_offset/provenance, exercise_id joined to a Samsung exercise row, and the referenced heart_rate JSON sidecar present; retain sidecar validity and chart_data sampling as quality context. Emit post_exercise_hrr_window_context_present only as boolean context presence for the breathing-feel check-in prompt. Do not compare HRR to a threshold or infer recovery/readiness/autonomic state. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open post_exercise_easy_cooldown copy. For this line, use the same source-qualified post-exercise window only to open one small water-drinking opportunity; do not infer hydration, fluid need, sweat loss, fatigue, recovery or safety.

Missing rows are unknown, not normal recovery and not poor recovery. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not substitute unrelated signals or infer health, diagnosis, score, service action, delivery, frequency, or deduplication.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: For each externally supplied recalled meal anchor, inspect the 45 minutes after the recalled meal time, not the later question time. Merge source-qualified positive-step intervals and sum overlap minutes. Emit when movement minutes are below 10 and the 45-minute follow-up window has already elapsed.

numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: operation/user recalled meal anchor plus 45 minute postmeal window with positive step movement minutes below 10 after the window has elapsed
numeric_parameters.question_collection_schedule: breakfast recall around 12:00, lunch recall around 15:00, dinner recall around 20:00; use recalled meal time as the anchor, not question time

detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing meal anchor, missing postmeal elapsed flag, missing provider source identity, unsupported provider, or provider-unobserved day returns no trigger/unknown. The absence of a meal answer is not interpreted as no meal; missing device rows do not infer off-device behavior.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: This trigger requires an externally supplied recalled meal anchor. Device data only calculates positive-step movement minutes after that supplied anchor. It is not meal inference, meal-content inference, glucose prediction, insulin-sensitivity inference, disease diagnosis, treatment, score, service action, real-time delivery, frequency, or deduplication.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit one row when recalled meal anchor, elapsed 45-minute follow-up window, source identity, and provider-observed day are present and the postmeal window contains fewer than 10 positive-step movement minutes.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Return no row/no_match when recalled meal anchor is missing, the postmeal window has not elapsed, provider is unsupported, source identity is missing, provider day is unobserved, or movement minutes are at least 10.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Apple v1: pair daily median WalkingSpeed and WalkingHeartRateAverage by local day; require at least 7 prior paired walking days in the prior 30 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of the prior speed median, and current walking HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Samsung v1: use walking/running exercise sessions with mean_speed and mean_heart_rate; require at least 7 prior same-type sessions in the prior 60 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of prior speed median, and current mean HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Emit only bounded lower-next-pace context when quality, coverage, duplicate and acute-context gates pass. Reuse the same source-qualified same-pace higher-HR context only to open lower-next-pace copy: lower the next movement anchor instead of continuing to push the same pace.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing paired speed/heart-rate context, fewer than 7 prior comparable observations, speed outside +/-5 percent similarity band, heart-rate ratio below 1.10, unresolved quality/coverage, unresolved presence/duplicate/acute-context filters, Missing rows are unknown, not normal fitness and not disease. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows, incomplete coverage, absent paired observations, failed quality gates, or daily aggregate-only data as normal fitness, target failure, disease, recovery/readiness, or a need to change exercise intensity.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Apple v1: pair daily median WalkingSpeed and WalkingHeartRateAverage by local day; require at least 7 prior paired walking days in the prior 30 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of the prior speed median, and current walking HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Samsung v1: use walking/running exercise sessions with mean_speed and mean_heart_rate; require at least 7 prior same-type sessions in the prior 60 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of prior speed median, and current mean HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Emit only bounded body-feel prompt context when quality, coverage, duplicate, acute-context, and no-recent-answer gates pass. Reuse the same source-qualified same-pace higher-HR context only to open keep-easy pacing copy: lower the next movement anchor instead of continuing to push the same pace.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing paired speed/heart-rate context, fewer than 7 prior comparable observations, speed outside +/-5 percent similarity band, heart-rate ratio below 1.10, unresolved quality/coverage, unresolved presence/duplicate/acute-context filters, or recent equivalent answer yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not normal fitness and not disease. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows, incomplete coverage, absent paired observations, failed quality gates, or daily aggregate-only data as normal fitness, target failure, disease, recovery/readiness, or a need to change exercise intensity.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Apple v1: pair daily median WalkingSpeed and WalkingHeartRateAverage by local day; require at least 7 prior paired walking days in the prior 30 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of the prior speed median, and current walking HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Samsung v1: use walking/running exercise sessions with mean_speed and mean_heart_rate; require at least 7 prior same-type sessions in the prior 60 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of prior speed median, and current mean HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Emit only bounded body-feel prompt context when quality, coverage, duplicate, acute-context, and no-recent-answer gates pass. Reuse the same source-qualified same-pace higher-HR context only to open keep-easy pacing copy: lower the next movement anchor instead of continuing to push the same pace.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing paired speed/heart-rate context, fewer than 7 prior comparable observations, speed outside +/-5 percent similarity band, heart-rate ratio below 1.10, unresolved quality/coverage, unresolved presence/duplicate/acute-context filters, or recent equivalent answer yields no trigger. detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: For each provider-local day, build source-qualified timestamped positive step/activity events. Use a 06:00-23:00 local waking observation window. Derive low/no-movement intervals as gaps between positive activity events inside that window, subtract overlapping sleep and workout/exercise intervals when source intervals are present, sum remaining gap minutes by local day, and convert to estimated_sedentary_like_inactivity_hours_per_day. Emit the fact41 above-target planning trigger when that value is > 8 hours/day. For replay calibration, evaluated days require the complete-day heuristic first_positive_activity_time <= 10:00 and last_positive_activity_time >= 20:00; operating implementations may replace this heuristic with a stronger provider wear/phone presence contract, but must not count unobserved time as sedentary-like inactivity without such coverage. provider_contracts.method: Aggregate Apple asleep-stage intervals by sleep-night end local day, require at least seven prior valid sleep nights in the preceding fourteen valid nights, calculate the prior median duration, and emit when current sleep duration is below 80 percent of that median.

provider_contracts.method: Use Samsung provider sleep_duration by sleep end local day, require at least seven prior valid sleep nights in the preceding fourteen valid nights, calculate the prior median duration, and emit when current sleep duration is below 80 percent of that median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Direct sleep-duration history only; no cognition, fatigue, recovery, readiness, sleep-quality, disease, prescription, service action, or runtime authority.

Boundary: Not cognitive impairment, attention score, reaction-time score, safety-critical fitness, fatigue diagnosis, recovery, readiness, sleep quality, disease, treatment, prescription, stimulant or supplement advice, service action, or runtime authority.. For this line, use the same short-sleep context only to open one optional afternoon-caffeine boundary action; do not infer caffeine intake, sleep quality, sleep need, sleepiness, fatigue, recovery or safety.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Aggregate provider HRV observations to a provider-local daily median. Aggregate sleep observations to the sleep end local date. For date D, require sleep_hours[D] < 6.0, current HRV[D] > 0, at least 7 positive HRV days in D-14 through D-1, and HRV[D] <= 0.8 * median(prior 14-day HRV values). Emit hrv_short_sleep_body_feel_context_present only when source identity, HRV timing/quality, sleep coverage, confounder filter, and no_recent_equivalent_feeling_answer are present. A recent equivalent feeling answer suppresses the prompt; it is not required to activate it. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open short_sleep_cardio_no_extra_push copy.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing HRV timing/quality, missing sleep duration, sleep >= 6 hours, fewer than 7 prior HRV days, current HRV above the low-ratio threshold, unresolved sleep/wear coverage, unresolved confounder filter, or recent equivalent feeling answer yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not normal recovery and not poor recovery. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not substitute unrelated signals or infer health, diagnosis, score, service action, delivery, frequency, or deduplication.

The user feeling answer is optional existing context; a recent equivalent answer suppresses a duplicate question rather than activating it.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Aggregate provider HRV observations to a provider-local daily median. Aggregate sleep observations to the sleep end local date. For date D, require sleep_hours[D] < 6.0, current HRV[D] > 0, at least 7 positive HRV days in D-14 through D-1, and HRV[D] <= 0.8 * median(prior 14-day HRV values). Emit hrv_short_sleep_body_feel_context_present only when source identity, HRV timing/quality, sleep coverage, confounder filter, and no_recent_equivalent_feeling_answer are present. A recent equivalent feeling answer suppresses the prompt; it is not required to activate it. Reuse the same source-qualified short-sleep plus low-HRV context only to open no-number-chase copy: avoid chasing or interpreting the HRV value or ratio.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing HRV timing/quality, missing sleep duration, sleep >= 6 hours, fewer than 7 prior HRV days, current HRV above the low-ratio threshold, unresolved sleep/wear coverage, unresolved confounder filter, or recent equivalent feeling answer yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not normal recovery and not poor recovery. Do not convert missing provider data, incomplete coverage, absent source identity, unresolved local-day assignment, absent HRV baseline, unresolved acute-context filter, or recent-answer suppression into HRV meaning, vagal tone, autonomic state, stress, sleep quality, fatigue, recovery/readiness, illness, exercise clearance, diagnosis, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: Short-sleep plus provider HRV context is a bounded paired sleep/vital-signal observation only. This line does not infer vagal tone, autonomic state, stress, sleep quality, fatigue, recovery/readiness, illness, arrhythmia, exercise clearance, training readiness, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, health outcome, disease risk, score, runtime authority, service action, delivery timing, frequency, or deduplication.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit context_present=true when source identity, valid HRV timing, sleep coverage, confounder filter, and no recent equivalent feeling answer are present; sleep_hours is under 6.0; at least 7 positive HRV days exist in the prior 14 days; and current daily HRV median is <= 80 percent of the prior 14-day HRV median.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Emit no trigger when source identity, HRV timing/value, sleep duration, coverage, confounder filter, baseline, low-HRV comparison, or prompt context is missing, when sleep is at least 6 hours, or when a recent equivalent feeling answer suppresses the prompt. Missing rows are unknown, not normal recovery and not poor recovery.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Emit no trigger when source identity, HRV timing/value, sleep duration, coverage, confounder filter, baseline, low-HRV comparison, or prompt context is missing, when sleep is at least 6 hours, or when a recent equivalent feeling answer suppresses the prompt. Missing rows are unknown, not normal recovery and not poor recovery.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: For each source-qualified provider sleep-duration series, assign each valid sleep record to a local sleep night, resolve naps/overlaps/duplicates, and build a current valid night plus prior 14 valid-night baseline window. Require at least seven prior valid nights. Compute prior_valid_night_median_minutes and emit context_present=true when current_sleep_duration_minutes < 0.8 * prior_valid_night_median_minutes. Use the context only to open non-safety-critical prioritization/postponement copy: choose one necessary task and postpone nonessential high-burden tasks or activities.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing sleep source, source identity, current valid night, local sleep-night assignment, timezone, nap/overlap resolution, coverage state, prior valid-night median, or seven prior valid nights yields no trigger. Missing nights are unknown, not zero sleep, not adequate sleep, and not a negative behavior label.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: The trigger supplies only source-qualified short-sleep planning context for prioritization/postponement copy. It does not infer cognitive impairment, attention, reaction time, safety-critical fitness, fatigue, recovery, readiness, sleep quality, disease, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, stimulant or supplement advice, score, runtime authority, service action, delivery timing, frequency, or deduplication.

output_schema.source_signal: Apple SleepAnalysis or Samsung sleep rows

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit context_present=true when current valid sleep duration is below 80 percent of the prior 14 valid sleep-night median, requiring at least seven prior valid nights. The output may only support non-safety-critical task prioritization/postponement copy.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Emit no trigger when sleep duration source, source identity, sleep-night assignment, nap/overlap resolution, current valid night, or seven prior valid nights are missing. Missing nights are unknown and must not be treated as zero sleep or adequate sleep.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: Light planning context only for choosing one necessary task and postponing nonessential high-burden items; not cognition, fatigue, recovery, readiness, sleep quality, disease, prescription, score, runtime authority, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service action.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Emit no trigger when sleep duration source, source identity, sleep-night assignment, nap/overlap resolution, current valid night, or seven prior valid nights are missing. Missing nights are unknown and must not be treated as zero sleep or adequate sleep.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Use the prior 14-night sleep baseline when at least 7 valid nights exist. Trigger when prior-night sleep duration is below 420 minutes or below 85 percent of the prior median, or sleep onset shifts at least 60 minutes from circular baseline, and the next day has a source-qualified activity-window proxy. Reuse the same source-qualified sleep-deviation next-day window context only to open no-full-reset copy: do not turn the whole day into a catch-up or reset plan. Reuse the same source-qualified sleep-deviation and next-day opportunity context only to open one optional daylight-environment action; no light exposure or circadian phase is inferred.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing sleep duration/onset, fewer than 7 prior valid nights, missing next-day activity-window evidence, or unresolved device/wear confidence yields no trigger. Do not convert missing sleep data, incomplete prior-night baseline, missing next-day activity window, absent source identity, unresolved local-day assignment, unresolved shift-work/clinical sleep-disorder filter, or missing device confidence into sleep disorder, fatigue, recovery/readiness, prescription, diagnosis, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic.

Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'sleep_timing_next_day_window_apple, sleep_timing_next_day_window_samsung'. Provider contracts= 2, preprocessing steps= 12, replay/calibration rows= 1. Required contexts are: multi_day_sleep_timing_or_duration_baseline, prior_night_sleep_timing_or_duration_deviation, next_day_steps_or_activity_minutes, personal_activity_baseline, available_light_activity_window, device_presence_or_wear_confidence, shift_work_or_clinical_sleep_disorder_filter, missingness_policy, available_window_copy_only. Supported use: Open a new general line that uses qualified sleep timing or duration deviation plus next-day activity context to suggest one nearby light-activity window.. Boundary: This is a practical sleep/activity composition context only. It is not sleep or exercise prescription, sleep restriction encouragement, mental-health claim, cardiometabolic risk prediction, performance optimization, readiness/recovery score, formula score, service action, diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice.. Reuse the same source-qualified sleep-deviation next-day window context only to open no-full-reset copy: do not turn the whole day into a catch-up or reset plan. Reuse the same source-qualified sleep-deviation and next-day opportunity context only to open one optional daylight-environment action; no light exposure or circadian phase is inferred.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: If any required context, provider contract input, preprocessing step, timezone/window assignment, coverage check, or duplicate-resolution prerequisite is unavailable, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not convert missing device data, missing user/profile input, or missing source coverage into a negative behavior label. Do not bypass the evidence boundary or create runtime delivery authority. Do not convert missing sleep data, incomplete prior-night baseline, missing next-day activity window, absent source identity, unresolved local-day assignment, unresolved shift-work/clinical sleep-disorder filter, or missing device confidence into sleep disorder, fatigue, recovery/readiness, prescription, diagnosis, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Use the prior 14-night sleep baseline when at least 7 valid nights exist. Trigger when prior-night sleep duration is below 420 minutes or below 85 percent of the prior median, or sleep onset shifts at least 60 minutes from circular baseline, and the next day has a source-qualified activity-window proxy. Reuse the same source-qualified sleep-deviation next-day window context only to open no-full-reset copy: do not turn the whole day into a catch-up or reset plan. Reuse the same source-qualified sleep-deviation and next-day opportunity context only to open one optional slow post-rest transition action; no standing response or safety state is inferred.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing sleep duration/onset, fewer than 7 prior valid nights, missing next-day activity-window evidence, or unresolved device/wear confidence yields no trigger. Do not convert missing sleep data, incomplete prior-night baseline, missing next-day activity window, absent source identity, unresolved local-day assignment, unresolved shift-work/clinical sleep-disorder filter, or missing device confidence into sleep disorder, fatigue, recovery/readiness, prescription, diagnosis, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic.

provider_contracts.method: Use positive Apple WalkingSpeed records grouped by local day; keep days with at least five records; compute daily P90 to avoid incidental slow segments; compare current daily P90 with the median of prior eligible days in the preceding fourteen calendar days when at least seven prior eligible days exist; emit context when current daily P90 is at or below 80 percent of that personal baseline. Do not infer cause or use a population gait threshold.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Walking speed is a descriptive personal activity-pacing context only; it is not a gait disorder, fall-risk, fatigue, recovery, health, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, score, service-action, delivery-cadence, or runtime-authority measure.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Read positive Apple WalkingSpeed records, convert values to meters per second, and group by provider-local day. A current local day is eligible only when it has at least five positive WalkingSpeed records. Compute the current day P90 from those records. Look back over the preceding fourteen calendar days and keep eligible prior days with their own daily WalkingSpeed P90; require at least seven prior eligible days. Compute the median of those prior daily P90 values. Emit the activity-pacing context when current_day_walking_speed_p90 <= 0.80 * prior_14day_eligible_day_daily_p90_median. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open walking_speed_drop_easy_pace copy. Reuse the same source-qualified walking-speed drop context only to open close-short copy: stop chasing extra distance, steps, or speed for the day and close the walking plan short.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Read positive Apple WalkingSpeed records, convert values to meters per second, and group by provider-local day. A current local day is eligible only when it has at least five positive WalkingSpeed records. Compute the current day P90 from those records. Look back over the preceding fourteen calendar days and keep eligible prior days with their own daily WalkingSpeed P90; require at least seven prior eligible days. Compute the median of those prior daily P90 values. Emit the activity-pacing context when current_day_walking_speed_p90 <= 0.80 * prior_14day_eligible_day_daily_p90_median. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open walking_speed_drop_easy_pace copy. Reuse the same source-qualified personal walking-speed context only to open one easy-pace action.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Assign each source-qualified moderate/vigorous aerobic activity event to a user-local date and user-local week after duplicate/overlap resolution. Count distinct local dates in the week with at least one qualified event. Trigger when the weekly distinct qualified day count is below the threshold of 3 days for an observed week. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open aerobic_low_day_next_anchor copy. For this line, reuse the same complete-week and explicit moderate/vigorous activity-day context only to open one optional supported-walking planning action; do not infer social availability, motivation, fitness, need, benefit, fatigue, recovery or safety.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: If event timestamps, user-local week boundary, source-qualified moderate/vigorous classification, duplicate resolution, or coverage context is missing, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not treat missing source rows or incomplete weekly coverage as zero aerobic activity. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not substitute unrelated signals or infer health, diagnosis, score, service action, delivery, frequency, or deduplication.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require a complete provider-qualified local seven-day window, valid strength-workout type and local-day normalization, resolved duplicates, qualified coverage, and fewer than two distinct source-qualified strength-training days. Emit one feasible-day planning opportunity; do not classify strength, adaptation, compliance, readiness, recovery, or safety.

numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: fewer than two valid source-qualified strength-training days in one complete local seven-day window

detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing or ambiguous event, workout type, local day, coverage, or duplicate state emits no trigger; missing data is unknown, not evidence of no strength activity.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: The weekly count is an observed activity-coverage context only; it is not strength, adaptation, fitness, guideline compliance, readiness, recovery, safety, disease, treatment, or outcome measurement.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit when a complete qualified local week has a distinct strength-day count below two.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when the week, event type, local day, coverage, provenance, or duplicate resolution is incomplete.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: Authoring context only; operating product owns timing, safety handling, suppression, frequency, delivery and deduplication.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when the week, event type, local day, coverage, provenance, or duplicate resolution is incomplete.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Within each ISO week, calculate the median sleep midpoint for weekday nights and weekend nights when both day types are observed. Mark weekend sleep shift when the weekend median midpoint is at least 90 minutes and at most 720 minutes later than the weekday median. Emit context only when a first-active-time observation exists on a weekend anchor day after that shift. This is a practical first-activity anchor context, not a social-jetlag or chronotype label. Reuse the same source-qualified weekend sleep-shift first-activity context only to open no-hard-reset copy: do not hard-reset with a larger activity push or fixed sleep/activity schedule. Reuse the same source-qualified weekend sleep-shift/first-activity context only to open existing no-fixed-rule copy: avoid turning one first-activity anchor into a fixed wake-time, optimal-time rule, perfect Monday reset, or daily compliance target. Use this source-qualified context only to open one flexible next-weekend wake-time anchor; do not infer a fixed schedule or sleep state.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing weekday or weekend sleep timing in the same ISO week, missing first-active-time context, missing morning activity window, missing personal sleep/activity baseline, high missing-wear ambiguity, acute illness, clinical sleep disorder context, shift work, or clinician-directed sleep schedule context yields no trigger. Do not convert missing provider data, incomplete coverage, absent source identity, unresolved local-day assignment, missing first activity observation, unresolved travel/shift-work/social-schedule filters, or missing timestamped activity into circadian disorder, sleep disorder, fatigue, recovery/readiness, prescription, diagnosis, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic. Do not convert missing provider data, insufficient weekday/weekend sleep history, unresolved first active time, insufficient morning steps/light-activity window, unresolved personal baseline, unresolved wear/phone confidence, missing wear filter, or incomplete local-day/timezone context into circadian disorder, sleep disorder, fatigue, recovery/readiness, fixed wake-time prescription, optimal-time rule, compliance target, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive FlightsClimbed records, reconcile source identity, sum by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current count is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded cumulative FlightsClimbed only; no equivalence to stair ability, strength, balance, intensity, or target.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded cycling distance by local day; require seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded cycling distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded exercise minutes by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded exercise-time change only; Apple field estimation is not adopted as individual intensity.

provider_contracts.method: On complete local days, detect a prior positive recorded exercise-time day followed by two complete days without a positive recorded value; missing coverage yields unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The signal is provider-recorded exercise time, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Count distinct valid stood-hour categories per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current count is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded category-count change, not standing duration, sedentary time, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded standing time by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded standing-time change only and is not a sedentary-time estimate.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded distance by local day; require at least seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded walking/running distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, health, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current active_time is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded active-time change, not energy balance, all-activity change, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day, require seven valid positive prior days, and emit on the second of two consecutive observed days below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded active_time gap only; missing data is not no movement.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-distance sessions, reconcile source identity, sum recorded distance by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current distance is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded exercise distance only; no equivalence to total movement or target.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-duration sessions, reconcile source identity, sum duration by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current duration is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded session duration only; no intensity or target equivalence.

provider_contracts.method: Resolve positive Samsung exercise sessions by local day; require a prior positive session, four subsequent complete coverage days without a session, and a three-day quiet window after a prior emitted context. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: This output describes a Samsung-recorded session gap only, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung activity.day_summary longest_active_time to one representative value per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded longest-bout change, not total activity, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive provider pedometer-distance rows, reconcile source identity and local day, aggregate one daily value, require seven valid prior days, and emit when the current daily value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded pedometer distance only; no equivalence to exercise-session distance or complete movement coverage.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require operating-supplied elevated-BP/hypertension context. Then compute the high-after-quiet rule: at least 7 positive prior days in the prior 14-day baseline, prior positive-day median, both immediately prior local days below that median, and current local-day activity signal greater than 150 percent of that median. Emit only the BP/HTN next-activity-lighten context.

numeric_parameters.activity_load_input_v1: daily step count or source-qualified activity-load source path with provider provenance

detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: If BP/HTN context or route boundary is not supplied by the operating product, emit no trigger. Missing source identity, insufficient prior positive days, missing prior two days, unresolved duplicate/overlap, low capture confidence, or red-flag/clinician restriction yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: The trigger uses source-qualified high-after-quiet activity-load context to support a lower-intensity pacing message for an externally confirmed elevated-BP/hypertension audience. It does not infer hypertension, blood pressure control, activity clearance, fatigue, readiness, overtraining, injury risk, treatment need, prescription, diagnosis, score, runtime authority, service action, or delivery timing.

output_schema.confirmed_elevated_bp_or_hypertension_co: boolean from operating product, not derived from device data

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit one row when confirmed elevated-BP/hypertension context is supplied by the operating product and the source-qualified high-after-quiet activity-load rule is met.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Return no row/no_match when BP/HTN context is not confirmed, route boundary is not supplied, red-flag/clinician exclusion is present, source identity is missing, prior-day baseline is insufficient, prior two days are not below median, current day is not above 150 percent of median, or provider coverage/overlap is unresolved.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: Operating product separately owns BP/HTN status source, route selection, red-flag/clinician exclusions, delivery timing, frequency, deduplication, and clinical safety handling. KDB output is a trigger-derived context row only.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Return no row/no_match when BP/HTN context is not confirmed, route boundary is not supplied, red-flag/clinician exclusion is present, source identity is missing, prior-day baseline is insufficient, prior two days are not below median, current day is not above 150 percent of median, or provider coverage/overlap is unresolved.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require operating-supplied confirmed_pneumonia_context and pneumonia_coaching_window_active. Then apply the copied high-activity burden trigger exactly: For each provider-specific active-energy signal, aggregate positive energy exposure by provider-local day. Do not compare Apple ActiveEnergyBurned and Samsung SOURCE_TYPE_ALL calorie values to each other. For current day D, require current active-energy exposure > 0, build a baseline from positive observed active-energy days in D-14 through D-1, and require at least 7 positive prior days. Emit active_energy_activity_context_present when energy[D] >= 1.5 * median(prior positive active-energy days). Use the context only to open no-extra-push copy; do not create a calorie target, energy-balance claim, fatigue/recovery judgment, delivery policy, frequency policy, or service action. Reuse the same source-qualified high active-energy context only to open next-day-light-start copy: keep the next first movement short/easy rather than stacking another hard activity because the previous day was high.

detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, unresolved local day, missing current energy, nonpositive current energy, fewer than 7 positive prior energy days, unresolved coverage, or unresolved duplicate handling yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero energy, not low activity, and not a reason to add activity. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows, unresolved local-day assignment, incomplete coverage, or duplicate/overlap ambiguity as fatigue, recovery/readiness, diagnosis, or need for prescription. If confirmed_pneumonia_context is false/missing or pneumonia_coaching_window_active is false/missing, emit no trigger. Missing activity source fields remain unknown; do not infer pneumonia, fatigue, recovery, severity, immune/inflammation state, overtraining, or activity clearance.

It does not infer energy balance, calorie deficit, weight change, fatigue, recovery/readiness, pneumonia severity, immune/inflammation state, activity clearance, overtraining, treatment, diagnosis, score, runtime authority, service action, delivery timing, frequency, or deduplication.
