provider_contracts.method: Read positive FlightsClimbed records, reconcile source identity, sum by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current count is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded cumulative FlightsClimbed only; no equivalence to stair ability, strength, balance, intensity, or target.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded cycling distance by local day; require seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded cycling distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded exercise minutes by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded exercise-time change only; Apple field estimation is not adopted as individual intensity.

provider_contracts.method: On complete local days, detect a prior positive recorded exercise-time day followed by two complete days without a positive recorded value; missing coverage yields unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The signal is provider-recorded exercise time, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Count distinct valid stood-hour categories per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current count is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded category-count change, not standing duration, sedentary time, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded standing time by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded standing-time change only and is not a sedentary-time estimate.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded distance by local day; require at least seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded walking/running distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, health, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current active_time is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded active-time change, not energy balance, all-activity change, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day, require seven valid positive prior days, and emit on the second of two consecutive observed days below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded active_time gap only; missing data is not no movement.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-distance sessions, reconcile source identity, sum recorded distance by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current distance is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded exercise distance only; no equivalence to total movement or target.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-duration sessions, reconcile source identity, sum duration by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current duration is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded session duration only; no intensity or target equivalence.

provider_contracts.method: Resolve positive Samsung exercise sessions by local day; require a prior positive session, four subsequent complete coverage days without a session, and a three-day quiet window after a prior emitted context. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: This output describes a Samsung-recorded session gap only, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung activity.day_summary longest_active_time to one representative value per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded longest-bout change, not total activity, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive provider pedometer-distance rows, reconcile source identity and local day, aggregate one daily value, require seven valid prior days, and emit when the current daily value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded pedometer distance only; no equivalence to exercise-session distance or complete movement coverage.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require operating-supplied confirmed pneumonia context and active pneumonia coaching window. Then reuse the replay-backed activity-volume baseline-gap family exactly: baseline-drop paths require current_daily_value < 0.5 * prior 14-day positive median with at least seven prior positive days; recorded-gap paths require the source-specific complete no-positive or below-half gap state. Emit only a small gradual re-entry context.

numeric_parameters.source_refs: NHS pneumonia page reviewed 2026-07-17; American Lung Association Pneumonia Treatment and Recovery updated 2025-08-14; NICE NG250 recovery information
numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: confirmed pneumonia context and active pneumonia coaching window plus any preserved source-specific activity-volume baseline-drop or recorded-gap trigger with prior 14 day baseline, seven valid prior positive days, current value below 0.5 of prior positive median, source-specific 2 or 4 day recorded-gap rules, and quiet window
numeric_parameters.guidance_basis: rest, do not rush recovery, gradual return to normal activities
numeric_parameters.required_context: confirmed_pneumonia_context; pneumonia_coaching_window_active; line-specific source-qualified sleep/activity context; coverage and missingness context; duplicate resolution; provider provenance

detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: If confirmed pneumonia context or pneumonia_coaching_window_active is not supplied by the operating product, emit no trigger. Missing source identity, incomplete coverage, insufficient baseline, unresolved duplicates, quiet-window failure, red flags, or clinician restriction yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: Official recovery guidance supports rest, not rushing recovery, and gradual return toward normal activities. This trigger only uses source-qualified activity-volume baseline-drop or recorded-gap context to support a small re-entry message for an externally confirmed pneumonia audience during an active coaching window. It does not infer pneumonia, recovery status, severity, hypoxemia, activity clearance, deterioration, fatigue, readiness, treatment, diagnosis, score, runtime authority, service action, or delivery timing. Source refs: NHS pneumonia page reviewed 2026-07-17; American Lung Association Pneumonia Treatment and Recovery updated 2025-08-14; NICE NG250 recovery information.

2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive FlightsClimbed records, reconcile source identity, sum by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current count is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded cumulative FlightsClimbed only; no equivalence to stair ability, strength, balance, intensity, or target.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded cycling distance by local day; require seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded cycling distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded exercise minutes by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded exercise-time change only; Apple field estimation is not adopted as individual intensity.

provider_contracts.method: On complete local days, detect a prior positive recorded exercise-time day followed by two complete days without a positive recorded value; missing coverage yields unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The signal is provider-recorded exercise time, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Count distinct valid stood-hour categories per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current count is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded category-count change, not standing duration, sedentary time, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded standing time by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded standing-time change only and is not a sedentary-time estimate.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded distance by local day; require at least seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded walking/running distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, health, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current active_time is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded active-time change, not energy balance, all-activity change, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day, require seven valid positive prior days, and emit on the second of two consecutive observed days below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded active_time gap only; missing data is not no movement.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-distance sessions, reconcile source identity, sum recorded distance by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current distance is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded exercise distance only; no equivalence to total movement or target.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-duration sessions, reconcile source identity, sum duration by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current duration is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded session duration only; no intensity or target equivalence.

provider_contracts.method: Resolve positive Samsung exercise sessions by local day; require a prior positive session, four subsequent complete coverage days without a session, and a three-day quiet window after a prior emitted context. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: This output describes a Samsung-recorded session gap only, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung activity.day_summary longest_active_time to one representative value per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded longest-bout change, not total activity, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive provider pedometer-distance rows, reconcile source identity and local day, aggregate one daily value, require seven valid prior days, and emit when the current daily value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded pedometer distance only; no equivalence to exercise-session distance or complete movement coverage.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require external pneumonia recovery context and reuse the replay-backed activity-volume baseline-gap family exactly: current_daily_value < 0.5 * prior 14-day positive median with at least seven prior positive days, or source-specific 2/4 day recorded-gap path. Emit only a task-splitting behavior opportunity.

numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: external pneumonia recovery context plus source-qualified activity-volume baseline drop or recorded gap with prior 14 day baseline, seven valid prior positive days, current value below 0.5 of prior positive median, source-specific 2 or 4 day gap rules, and quiet window
numeric_parameters.signal_window: local day or source-specific recorded gap

detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing external context, source identity, coverage, baseline, quiet window, red-flag boundary, or clinician boundary emits no trigger; missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: NHS and NHLBI guidance support rest, light activity and not forcing normal activity. The device signal only opens a source-qualified activity-volume opportunity; it does not infer pneumonia, recovery, hypoxemia, fatigue, deterioration, activity clearance, treatment, diagnosis, score, service action, or delivery timing.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit one row when external pneumonia recovery context and any source-specific activity-volume baseline-gap path match.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when external context, coverage, source identity, quiet window, or safety boundary is absent.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: KDB output is a trigger-derived behavior opportunity only; operating product owns clinical context, timing, suppression, escalation, delivery, frequency, and deduplication.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require operating-supplied confirmed pneumonia context and active pneumonia coaching window before applying the copied source trigger. For each source-qualified provider sleep-duration series, assign each valid sleep record to a local sleep night, resolve naps/overlaps/duplicates, and build a current valid night plus prior 14 valid-night baseline window. Require at least seven prior valid nights. Compute prior_valid_night_median_minutes and emit context_present=true when current_sleep_duration_minutes < 0.8 * prior_valid_night_median_minutes. Use the context only to open non-safety-critical prioritization/postponement copy: choose one necessary task and postpone nonessential high-burden tasks or activities.

detail_calculation_rules.calculation_rule: Require externally supplied pneumonia context/window/activity boundary plus a complete source-qualified local seven-day activity window below half the median of three prior positive personal seven-day totals. Open one next-week light-activity planning action; do not infer pneumonia, recovery, dyspnea, oxygenation, fatigue, severity, fitness, safety, exercise clearance or adherence.
detail_calculation_rules.missingness_policy: Missing any external condition/window/activity boundary, provider identity, coverage, baseline window or uncertainty boundary emits no trigger; missing data is unknown, not low activity.

external_context_contract.evidence_boundary: NHLBI and American Lung Association support light activity and avoiding overdoing daily activity. Device data supplies only a weekly behavior opportunity and does not measure pneumonia, recovery, dyspnea, oxygenation, fatigue, severity, fitness, safety, exercise clearance, diagnosis, treatment, adherence, delivery, frequency or deduplication.

output_contract.emit_rule: Emit one row only when external pneumonia/window/activity-boundary context and a complete qualified weekly activity-volume opportunity are present.
output_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when any external context, provider identity, baseline window, coverage or uncertainty boundary is missing.
output_contract.downstream_contract_note: KDB output opens one bounded next-week light-activity planning opportunity only; operating product owns timing, suppression, escalation, delivery, frequency and deduplication.

negative_contract.no_emit_rule: Do not emit when any external context, provider identity, baseline window, coverage or uncertainty boundary is missing.
missingness_policy: Missing or invalid Apple duration type, timestamp, value/duration, unit, source identity, or unresolved duplicate/overlap yields no source row for this trigger.
If local-day assignment, non-overlap reconciliation, or seven-day window coverage cannot be established, emit unknown/no trigger. Missing days are unknown, not zero activity.
Fewer than three immediately prior valid positive seven-day windows, absent prior median, or prior median <= 0 yields unknown/no trigger.
If current seven-day total is not below 50 percent of the prior median, or if the crossing is not new after the quiet window, emit no trigger.
Any failed prerequisite emits null/no trigger.
Missing or invalid Samsung start_time, duration, source identity/provenance, or unresolved duplicate/overlap yields no source row for this trigger.
If local-day assignment, non-overlap reconciliation, or seven-day window coverage cannot be established, emit unknown/no trigger. Missing days are unknown, not zero activity.
Fewer than three immediately prior valid positive seven-day windows, absent prior median, or prior median <= 0 yields unknown/no trigger.
If current seven-day total is not below 50 percent of the prior median, or if the crossing is not new after the quiet window, emit no trigger.
Any failed prerequisite emits null/no trigger.

deterministic_execution_order: 1. Accept only allowed provider fields and declared external context inputs.
2. Apply provider normalization and preprocessing steps in ascending step_order.
3. If any required input is unknown, missing, ambiguous, or fails coverage, emit no trigger.
4. Evaluate the declared trigger_rule and detail calculation rules without adding service policy.
5. Emit the declared output_schema or the declared null_reason; never infer a missing value as zero or false.
